newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins Asia Cellular Satellite order.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins Asia Cellular Satellite order.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group LM Ericsson AB said it had signed a contract worth 1.5 billion crowns to supply satellite and mobile phones to a group of Asian companies led by Asia Cellular Satellite.

The order was placed by Asia Cellular Satellite (ACeS) in cooperation with its partners Jasmine International Overseas Co. of Thailand, PT Satelit Nusantara of Indonesia, and the Philippine Long Distance Telephone Company.

The dual-mode satellite and mobile telephones, which will be delivered in 1999, will be able to communicate with the Garuda satellite as well as with the GSM and AMPS mobile phone networks, Ericsson said in a statement.
It called its cooperation with ACeS "an important step on the road to real mobile communications for people in large areas of Asia".
